I just brewed a new batch and the recipe told me to add 1.6oz of freshly grated orange peel. Does anyone here know what (if any) taste difference there is between fresh orange peel and dried orange peel? Link to recipe for those who are curious.
Fresh Orange Peel in a Brew
Personally, I don't think you would get much taste difference. Ideally, the only thing you are removing in the drying process is water so the oils in the orange peel should still persist.

Though you have to remember that dried orange peel weighs less than fresh orange peel since you're removing the water. So it will take fewer ounces of dried orange peel to get the same amount of oils as fresh orange peel, if that makes sense.
The weight would be considerably different due to the lack of water. I think if you could substitute a proper amount of dried peel you would be fine, though.

In terms of cooking, I tend to notice more intense but less fresh flavor from dried ingredients like dried bail. That being said it may not necessarily translate to a brew. Take it with a grain of salt.

Tox https://tox.im/

What is tox?

Tox is a highly privacy focused skype replacement, co-created by the maker of ”megaupload”

It is also cross/multiplatform. I-devices, IOS, Windows, Unix-like, Android, etcetera, all have a client that can communicate with each others.

Installing tox

Grab the file from here: https://wiki.tox.im/Binaries

First of all, depending on platform, you must choose the file in accordance to it.

But, assuming it is:

Windows:

Don’t choose “Utox”. Neither 32-bit or 64-bit. But DO choose “Qtox”, but not 64-bit, the 32-bit version only.

Even if you have a 64-bit system.

The reason to choose 32-bit Qtox , is that there are a lot of versions, but many are unstable, with lackluster features. 32-bit Qtox is the most stable version for windows. Both in terms of setting costumization, audio/video chatting, UI and file sharing, among others.

Android: only a few android devices currently support Tox, and as of yet, the features are severely limited: https://wiki.tox.im/Antox

Running tox properly

The libraries and such that tox uses are embedded in tox. You don’t need to install anything else.

But also, some anti-virus/anti-malware programs don’t know what tox is, and Quarantine the EXE file, that you would otherwise use to run it.

If the EXE file is not

Go into your antivirus software’s quarantine and “restore” all TOX related/named files.

Now to open tox, simply go into the folder, and click the EXE file :P you can also attach it to the menu-bar for easy access.

Adding friends/setting up

To have Qtox, you don’t need an email/registration. Just type a name and password, and bam. You can even have multiple profiles, all from one profiles login.

To add friends, you need contact with them in some way or another, since you will need their “Tox ID”.

To find this, click your profile, and copy it, and give it to them. It’s a very long string, consisting of numbers and big letters.

(you can also use the QR code)

You have an array of options in terms of customization

Color theme. Whether it autostarts/logs on at windows startup, whether it keeps chat, timestamps, all the basic, and sometimes, tech savvy shit.

Also, the Tox profile (which you can just delete by deleting the program), consists of different ways to recognize/personalize. A “Phrase”, your profile name, and an avatar picture. Remember to set it all up at some point :P

Camera/audio:

Set up the right audio and camera devices in the settings (the cog).

The camera is a bit tricky. Make sure no other program is using the camera, or it will appear as a black screen to the other person. You won’t see a preview of your camera. Sadly, currently, camera resolution resets down to fairly low, every time you start up tox.

So make sure to set it to something without black borders, high quality/frame rate that your camera/computer/internet can still capacitate, as well as the receivers computer/internet can capacitate.

You can stretch the other persons camera window to make it larger.

You can also preview camera in the settings.

Using tox/chatting/features

Tox is very similar to MSN messenger. Chat, share files. Camera/audio chat.

greentext

Smileys, etcetera.

Also, depending on the platform, it has different features: https://wiki.tox.im/Clients#Features (this is the bottom of the page, scroll up to see the looks of the clients)
